name: slime-eruption-decline-loses-earned-damage
notes:
Slime Eruption (m3zkl7lpvn, ACTION): "You may banish any amount of fire element Slime ally cards and up to two non-fire element Slime ally cards from your graveyard. For each card banished this way, choose a unit and deal 1 damage to it. [Class Bonus] Floating Memory." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): this fixture documents Slime Eruption CURRENTLY losing ALL earned damage instances the moment the player declines a further banish offer via PASS -- the identical `dontSkipOnPass` omission bug class already pinned for Slime's Blessing elsewhere in this same batch (slimes-blessing-level-and-buff-counters), now confirmed on a second, independent card.

Root cause (confirmed live with a standalone debug harness, mirroring the Slime's Blessing investigation): SlimeEruptionBanishLoop() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~25030) queues a paired MZMAYCHOOSE + CUSTOM 'SlimeEruptionBanishPick' decision (~25048) each time it offers another graveyard Slime to banish; $customDQHandlers['SlimeEruptionBanishPick'] (~25051) is written to call SlimeEruptionDamageStep($player, $count) -- which deals 1 damage per card ALREADY banished -- when `$lastDecision === "PASS"` (the player declining a further banish). But Core/DecisionQueueController.php's ExecuteStaticMethods() CUSTOM case unconditionally skips invoking ANY CUSTOM handler when the preceding answer was 'PASS' unless that decision was queued with dontSkipOnPass=1; SlimeEruptionBanishLoop's own AddDecision call for 'SlimeEruptionBanishPick' does NOT pass dontSkipOnPass, so the handler's own PASS-triggered SlimeEruptionDamageStep() call is dead code whenever the player actually declines.

Confirmed live: with two Red Slime copies (mttsvbgl6f, FIRE) seeded in the graveyard, banishing ONE for real (confirmed: it successfully moves to myBanish) and then declining the SECOND offer via PASS leaves the decision queue fully drained (AllQueuesEmpty=YES) but the champion's Damage stays 0 -- the 1 damage earned for the 1 card already banished is silently lost, and no MZCHOOSE damage-target decision is ever even offered. (If the player instead banishes every eligible graveyard Slime until none remain, SlimeEruptionBanishLoop's own `if(empty($choices))` branch at ~25043 calls SlimeEruptionDamageStep() directly, bypassing the dispatcher's PASS-skip guard entirely -- that exhaustion path works correctly, the same shape already shown to work for Slime's Blessing's 'exactly 3 picks, no decline' path.) Confidence: HIGH / directly confirmed live, by the same method (standalone debug harness tracing decision-queue state and field Damage step by step) already used to isolate the Slime's Blessing instance of this bug class.

Slime Eruption's element is FIRE, native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion, so no Subcards lineage patch is needed. This fixture pins the CURRENT (buggy, damage-losing) observed behavior as a regression baseline so a future fix to this missing dontSkipOnPass flag (there are now two confirmed call sites needing it: this one and SlimesBlessingAskTarget's) is easy to spot. The separate [Class Bonus] Floating Memory clause is a reusable-elsewhere cost-payment mechanic, not independently re-tested here.

rulesClauses: You may banish any amount of fire element Slime ally cards and up to two non-fire element Slime ally cards from your graveyard. For each card banished this way, choose a unit and deal 1 damage to it.

engineBug.summary: Confirmed live, a second independent instance of the Slime's Blessing dontSkipOnPass omission bug class: SlimeEruptionBanishLoop()'s AddDecision call for the paired 'SlimeEruptionBanishPick' CUSTOM decision (Custom/GameLogic.php ~25048) omits dontSkipOnPass:1, so the handler's own PASS-triggered SlimeEruptionDamageStep() call (which deals damage for already-banished cards) is never reached when the player declines a further banish. Banishing one card then declining leaves the queue empty with 0 damage dealt, even though 1 damage was earned.
engineBug.affectedFunction: SlimeEruptionBanishLoop's AddDecision(..., "CUSTOM", "SlimeEruptionBanishPick", 1) call (Custom/GameLogic.php ~25048), missing dontSkipOnPass:1; dispatched through Core/DecisionQueueController.php's ExecuteStaticMethods() CUSTOM case (~line 131). Same bug class and same fix shape as SlimesBlessingAskTarget's analogous omission (documented in slimes-blessing-level-and-buff-counters/meta.json).
